reason: Notify Timothy Jones's guardian-facing proxy application of status changes on his pediatric dental referral (Task/task-referral-tracking), so the guardian sees milestone updates (referral created, appointment confirmed, and — at later interactions — encounter complete / care plan available) without having to call either office. Timothy is a minor; notifications go to the guardian proxy app, not to Timothy.

note.text: Per the HL7 FHIR Subscriptions R4 Backport IG, same pattern established for UC01/UC02: the SubscriptionTopic canonical URL is carried directly in Subscription.criteria, not via a separate extension. This single Subscription spans the whole UC03 episode and is a guardian-proxy subscription (minor patient). Patient-visible milestones: referral created (I1), appointment confirmed (~I1/I2 boundary), and visit-complete / care-plan-available (Interaction 4, when the referral Task reaches outcome-final and CarePlan/careplan-perio is produced) — this last milestone now fires (no longer deferred). IMPORTANT non-events (must fire nothing to the guardian app): (1) the Interaction 2 pre-encounter medical-records exchange (provider-to-provider, via Connie); (2) the Interaction 3 prior-authorization cycle for D4341 (CRD/DTR/PAS is back-office and produces no patient-facing notification); and (3) the Interaction 4 provider-to-provider summary deliveries themselves (only the patient-facing visit-complete/care-plan milestone surfaces, not the backend routing to the pediatrician/endocrinologist).
